header: Common doubts answered next to the button
lead: Badge, heading, one button and a plain link above a row of reassurances. Three usually work best; a fourth starts to sound anxious.
note: Signup happens on the linked page. This band has no form fields, so it collects no data.

reassurances.title: One objection each
reassurances.text: Each has an icon, a title and one sentence, like the rest of the catalogue.

reassurances.title: Beside the button
reassurances.text: Readers see the answer before they decide, not after.

reassurances.title: Zero to four
reassurances.text: With no items, the band is a plain call to action and still looks complete.
